# Professional Service Automation — consulting realization kernel

> Utilization, WIP, contract/milestone billing, partner-level profitability, and Postgres RLS. Timesheets are an input to realization, not the product. Not Kimai.

Community and Copilot agents: read AGENTS.md first. Factory overlay is docs/factory-overlay.md.
